question: After the authorization and lifecycle defects are fixed, should OpenClaw ship and permanently own this opt-in custom-widget execution and approval boundary?
rationale: The feature runs agent-authored code in the operator browser and adds capability-gated asset serving; mechanical correctness cannot decide whether that long-term product and security obligation is accepted.

options.title: Fix and accept the boundary
options.body: Repair the exact-head defects and merge after explicit security and product sign-off.

options.title: Ship trusted widgets only
options.body: Retain Workspaces and built-in widgets while removing agent-authored custom widget execution.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged until permanent product and security ownership is explicit.

recommendation.title: Fix and accept the boundary
recommendation.body: Repair the exact-head defects and merge after explicit security and product sign-off.

likelyOwner.reason: The consolidated branch and most recent boundary-hardening work make this contributor the clearest available decision router.
